text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So yeah, I'm all ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Forgive me. In my longing anticipation, 
I got ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The wind pressure reaches all the way 
here... That's Yaeno for ya, ssut. Though 
something like this isn't gonna break it, 
ssut—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This ultra-thick titanium breaking board 
is—!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Last year's broke almost right after you 
got it, after all. But this year, I 
tracked down something built different!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see. Indeed, it seems this is not 
something one can overcome with 
half-hearted resolve.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, with enough training, there is 
nothing that cannot be pierced!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san, another year brings another 
splendid trial! Shall we head straight to 
the dojo?!
